resumen: Pull-ups with palms facing you and hands closer together. The biceps takes on much more than in the overhand version.
ejecucion: Hang from the bar with your palms facing you, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Pull by driving your elbows down and your chest to the bar.
Come up until your chin passes above the bar.
Lower under control until your arms are fully straight.
If you cannot get up, use a band or an assisted version; swinging does not count.
matices: In the cited work the lats were activated equally in both versions (117-130 %), but pectoralis major and biceps worked significantly more underhand, and lower trapezius more overhand. They are two exercises with the same pattern and a different split, not one better than the other.
